verdict.rationale: Bun writes a readable `bun.lock`, and `--frozen-lockfile` installs the exact locked versions without updating the lockfile, so per-project package pins are respected. Overrides/resolutions and workspace catalogs add further control over pinned versions, and existing npm/yarn/pnpm lockfiles are migrated so prior pins carry over. Missing for 10: any evidence of pinning tool versions per project (e.g. the Bun/package-manager version itself or CLI tools, since `-g` installs are global), and independent or hands-on corroboration that pins are honored.
